recipe.title: Assign dental clinic rooms to overlapping bookings
recipe.scenario: Assign rooms to three synthetic bookings with the same fixed appointment block. Each booking has an approved list of rooms, and no room can be used twice. This example handles room allocation only. It does not set appointment durations, evaluate clinical suitability, manage room turnover, or decide when anyone receives care.

field.name: booking-labels
field.description: Synthetic booking labels in order: Booking A, Booking B, Booking C. No patient information is needed.

field.name: room-labels
field.description: Rooms in zero-based order: Room North, Room East, Room West.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Consecutive booking and room index pairs: 0,0; 0,2; 1,0; 1,1; 2,1; 2,2. Use only room options approved by the clinic.

field.name: preferred-booking-a-room
field.description: Optional preferred room index for Booking A. The example prefers Room West (2). This does not override eligibility.

field.name: assigned-rooms
field.description: For a feasible plan, one room index per booking. The preferred example yields 2,0,1 in booking order.
